title: Modularize adaptive load probes and reduce regression flakiness
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Refactor the existing end-to-end load/bench harness to introduce a modular 'probe' abstraction that can run adaptive sampling, synthetic user patterns, and deterministic replay. Primary goals: reduce flaky regression runs, make probes pluggable for language runtimes (node/rust/python), and centralize telemetry to a single metrics contract so downstream dashboards and SLO checks are stable.
comments: 2025-01-16 | Aisha P.: Scoping complete. Spike showed >30% false positives in the regression suite caused by brittle timing assumptions and per-run random seed drift. Proposal: probe abstraction + deterministic seeding + optional warmup latency collar.

2025-01-22 | Jonah K.: Implemented probe interface and basic NodeJS adapter. Ran 20 synthetic regression runs against canary and observed flakiness drop from 18% to 7% on toy model. POC branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/perf-harness/pull/412
2025-01-29 | Radhika S. (SRE): Review feedback - centralize histogram buckets and add trace correlation ID to each probe event. Added checklist for compliance with existing tracing middleware.

2025-02-04 | Jonah K.: Upgraded golang test runner deps (go.metrics -> go.instrument v2) to fix metric tag cardinality explosion. Note: upgrade introduced one deprecated API use — created follow-up ENG-142379 to finish migration.
2025-02-11 | Design review (Marco D.): Probe configuration UX needs a concise YAML schema for canary authors; shared spec in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-probe-spec

2025-02-15 | Jonah K.: Added deterministic-seed option and 'steady-state' warmup stage to default probes. Nightly regression (2025-02-15) showed flakiness 2.4% across 100 runs. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/Perf/regression-harness

2025-02-20 | QA (Evelyn L.): Found one remaining timing-dependent test around KV-cache priming for long-context scenarios. Root cause: shared in-memory cache between parallel probe workers. Plan: move to per-probe cache namespaces; will implement next sprint.
